title: Cyberpunk 2077 is getting a live-action movie 🎬
subject: cyberpunk2077
description:
Who should play V? 👇

On October 8, 2026, Deadline reported that Paramount Pictures is developing a live-action Cyberpunk 2077 movie, produced by Lorenzo di Bonaventura (Transformers) with CD Projekt Red co-producing. CD Projekt co-CEO Michał Nowakowski confirmed the partnership on X. No director, cast, story or release date has been announced. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 premieres on Netflix on October 20.

Sources: Deadline via GamesRadar+ (Oct 8, 2026), TweakTown (Oct 8, 2026), Push Square (Oct 8, 2026), Michał Nowakowski on X (Oct 8, 2026)
Game footage © CD PROJEKT RED.

scenes.text: Cyberpunk 2077 is becoming a live-action movie.
On October 8, Deadline reported that Paramount Pictures is developing the film.
Transformers producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura is on board, with CD Projekt Red co-producing.
CD Projekt co-CEO Michał Nowakowski confirmed the deal, calling Paramount a partner that shares their creative ambitions.
There's no director, cast, story or release date yet.
